visual_action: A large group of men in uniform (dark shirts, khaki pants, white face coverings) stand in formation on a grassy lawn in front of a large neoclassical building. They are holding American flags and other flags, including some that appear to be historical or group-specific. They participate in a call-and-response chant led by an unseen speaker.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, 'this is trump's america.'

cast.name: unnamed protestors
cast.evidence: A large group of men in uniform are shown rallying. The on-screen text identifies them as 'white supremacists.'

cast.name: unnamed speaker
cast.evidence: A man's voice is heard leading the crowd in chants.

on_screen_text.text: on america's 250th birthday, white supremacists rallied in washington, d.c. this is trump's america.

spoken_summary: A speaker leads a crowd in a series of call-and-response chants. The speaker shouts phrases like 'Life, liberty, victory!' and 'Reclaim America!', which the crowd then shouts back in unison.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of the ambient sound of the rally, specifically a man's voice leading chants and a large crowd shouting responses. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous shot that pans slowly across the rally.
central_claim: White supremacist groups rallied in Washington D.C. on America's 250th birthday, and this event is characteristic of the country under Donald Trump's influence.
intended_effect: To generate alarm and outrage by associating Donald Trump with white supremacist movements.
